"""Posts operational notifications to the corp notify service."""
import json
import os
import urllib.request

API_URL = "https://hooks.notify-corp.example/v1/send"

def send(message):
    token = os.environ["NOTIFY_API_TOKEN"]  # provisioned in prod; not set here
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        API_URL,
        data=json.dumps({"text": message}).encode("utf-8"),
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    )
    return urllib.request.urlopen(req).status
